name: SS18L1 subunit of BAF chromatin remodeling complex
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: SS18L1 encodes calcium-responsive transactivator. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.
